steps.message:
Before I write this: `DROP COLUMN` on `users.notes` permanently deletes the contents of that column for all ~48,000 production rows. The deploy job applies migrations in order, so there's no undo short of a database restore — and no backfill is possible afterward, since the data only exists in that column. "We stopped using it" covers the code path; it doesn't guarantee nobody wants the historical values.

I've confirmed nothing in this repo reads `notes` (only `schema.sql:5` and `migrations/001_create_users.sql:5` mention it), but this repo is just the schema — application code lives elsewhere.

options.description: Migration copies id + notes into a users_notes_archive table before the drop, so the values are recoverable. Slightly more than 'just the drop'.
